gpt.rationale: The sequence stays mostly subtle and self-effacing for an introvert—frequent embarrassed/downplayed reactions and small smiles fit well—though a few broader beats like repeated anxious/determined choices feel slightly more outward than her reserved profile.

claude.rationale: Heavy reliance on 'embarrassed' fits her reserved, self-conscious nature and the subtle sad-then-smile arc lands well, though the loud opening 'anxious' shout and repeated identical sprites slightly flatten otherwise accurate emotional turns.
